summary: Frontend-only testing for search functionality on 7 pages (Inventory Stock, Suppliers, MRP, Purchase Orders, Purchase Invoices, Manufacturing Orders, Routings) and Stores collapsible sidebar with Stock/Transfer History/GRN sub-items. All 11 test cases passed successfully.
passed_tests: Inventory Stock page: Search input exists (data-testid='stock-search-input'), filters items by part number or name - verified with 'Steel' search reducing 14 rows to 1
Suppliers page: Search input exists (data-testid='supplier-search-input'), filters suppliers by name/code
MRP page: Search input exists (data-testid='mrp-search-input'), filters demand and suggestions by part number/name
Purchase Orders page: Search input exists (data-testid='po-search-input'), filters POs by PO number/supplier/item
Purchase Invoices page: Search input exists (data-testid='invoice-search-input'), filters invoices
Manufacturing Orders page: Search input exists (data-testid='mo-search-input'), filters MOs by MO number/item
Routings tab: Search input exists (data-testid='routing-search-input'), filters routings
Sidebar: Stores is collapsible (data-testid='nav-stores-group') with chevron expand/collapse
Sidebar: Stores sub-items exist - Stock, Transfer History, GRN links
Stores Stock tab: Shows inventory data with search (data-testid='stores-stock-search') - verified filtering with 'Steel' reducing 14 rows to 1
Stores Stock tab: Same columns as Inventory page (Part Number, Name, Category, Current Stock, Safety Stock, Reorder Point, Unit Cost, Value)
